map.税额 = 不含税 × 税率 使用指南: Tax = Excl. Price × Rate — User Guide
map.输入不含税销售额与增值税税率，按 税额=不含税×税率 计算增值税额并得出含税总价: Enter the tax-exclusive sales amount and VAT rate to compute the VAT as tax = excl. × rate and derive the tax-inclusive total, for price-tax conversion when a general taxpayer issues a VAT invoice directly from a tax-exclusive amount.
map.由不含税销售额直接计算增值税额与含税价。: Compute VAT and the tax-inclusive price directly from the tax-exclusive sales amount.
map.已知不含税销售额与税率，算销项税额与含税总额。: Given the tax-exclusive sales and rate, compute the output VAT and tax-inclusive total.
map.销售报价、开票时做价税合计。: Combine price and tax for sales quotes and invoicing.
map.对比 13% 与 9% 税率的含税差异。: Compare the tax-inclusive difference between 13% and 9% rates.
map.：税额 9 元、含税 109 元，比 13% 少 4 元税。: : tax 9 CNY, tax-inclusive 109 CNY, 4 CNY less tax than at 13%.
map.不含税价怎么理解？: How to understand the tax-exclusive price?
map.是增值税的计税依据，不含本环节增值税额，含税价=不含税价×(1+率)。: It is the VAT taxable base, excluding this stage's VAT; tax-inclusive price = tax-exclusive price × (1 + rate).
map.一般纳税人的销项税可扣进项税，本工具仅算单笔销项，未涉及抵扣。: A general taxpayer's output VAT can offset input VAT; this tool computes a single output VAT and does not involve deductions.
